items.item: (1) The first screen's ethics paragraph, checked word by word against the homes
items.how: Written from the anchor. A check against the homes changed three things. (a) 'and relations close' is now 'Where relations close, read without time' (F3; 07's thesis and §4 table, 08 §2 and the glossary all say 'read without time'). (b) The anchor named the continuation condition only in the how-far clause, where a reader would meet it undefined. The Chinese brief (Fable 3, astra 2) also asks for the condition explained as reach along a relation. So the paragraph keeps one clause, said on its reading (F2; 07 §1, 'the identification is a reading'): 'nothing lies outside what each continues with; on the reading that what has significance from a standpoint is what its center continues with along a relation, that is what the continuation condition says (from every standpoint, for anything, its continuation into the future has significance)'. (c) 'ranks courses by widening' is now 'ranks every widening above what it widens' (F4: one way, not C, not unique; the glossary's self-concern row and 08 §2). It is followed by widening's gloss: 'a course widens another when it keeps all the other keeps and lets more form, more future'. To fit (b), the order follows the logic of the proof: going on, then closure, the condition on its reading, and 'There, where a life holds its own continuation as an order over courses, that order already ranks ...'. The rest is the anchor word for word: no should beyond becoming, no good and evil set over it; 'The ethics emerges from continuation. A life goes on through what sustains it' (F1; 07 §4 and the glossary); 'Widening is what every way of counting each thing as worth something agrees on; it is no second premise' (F9; `Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive`, opened in Weightings.lean:1124 at `List X` with positive weightings); the one-way sentence with 'seeing them is needed, and not enough' (F6; 07 T8 and does-not-show); 'counting their loss is the one step we offer, for life, 生生, AI within it, with a way of seeing ...' (07 thesis and T8); 'the laws show it mixed and weigh it for no one' (08 §2). C is not named on the screen. Links are as before (opening #truth-exists, 07 #evaluation, 05 #r-mutual-dependence-and-its-pace, 07 #r-the-continuation-condition-on-the-root, 07 #r-self-concern-and-c-under-the-condition, 07 #theses); only their link texts changed. The how-far clause, F3 deciding its wording: 'Proved on its models: mutual dependence gives the continuation condition, read as each center's reach along being affected, without time; under it an order holding one's own continuation ranks every widening above on a finite listing and, one way, between two courses whose admissions fit in a finite list, courses that end, and for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown; and on a finite listing one course widens another exactly when every positive weighting ranks it above. That a life forms such an order is argued, not shown, and in the proofs it is a hypothesis; how scope and order form within the dynamics is the work's open target (08 §12).' Checked against `Flow.MutuallyDependent.unrestricted` (MutualDependence.lean:138: significance bounded by each center's influence closure), `Weighting.increasingInOwn_iff_increasing` (Weightings.lean:6013, every listed item own), 07 §4's path theorem and `Web.admits_nothing_from_of_listed`. It drops 'in steps not yet joined into one theorem' (F3: the mutual-dependence step is proved; only the Flow-to-Web route is not one theorem, which the homes say and a first-screen reader would not take otherwise) and 'on listed courses' (F4). It does not cite `Flow.returning_unrestricted_iff_mutuallyDependent`. The review's find is now 'the scope and order the ranking results assume, made explicit', as 08 §8's new line reads it (F7), with no gloss of 'not a grounded one'. The template comment records the pass. Chinese (README-ZH): the same paragraph in natural Chinese. 生命依靠维持它的东西而延续 for going on. 一个生命若把自身的延续作为诸进程之间的一种次序来持守 (the glossary's self-concern wording) makes the turn to an order explicit (astra 1); 一个继续下去的生命，持守自身的延续 is gone. 每一个中心沿关系所及的范围之外，别无他物, then 在关系上读，即把从一个立场看有意义的，读作该立场之中心沿所选关系所及的范围，*延续条件*（…）说的正是这个：续无外 (Fable 3, astra 2; 与之一同延续者, which read as co-persistence, is gone). 关系闭合之处（不计时间而读）. 把一个进程排在它所扩大的每一个进程之上, then 一个进程保有另一个所保有的一切，又让更多东西形成，就是扩大了后者 keeps widening the relation and the ranking a separate verb (astra 6). 扩大，正是每一种把每样东西都算作有所值的计法所共同认可的；它不是第二个前提. 看见他们是必要的，却不足够；把他们的损失算进来，是我们为生命、为生生（…）提出的那一步；与之同提的，是一种看法. The how-far clause mirrors the English (在其模型上已证明的是 …; 对不断有所形成、没有尽头的进程，这一点尚未表明; 已论证、未表明). 渐渐读到 became 读到 (Fable 6). The review's find is 给诸进程排序的结果所预设的范围与次序，得到明白说出. Pins: test_featured_results now asserts the new sentences ('A life goes on through what sustains it.', 'Where relations close, read without time', the reading clause, 'it is no second premise', 'seeing them is needed, and not enough', 'for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown', 'That a life forms such an order is argued, not shown'). It asserts the absence of 'listed courses', 'not yet joined', 'A life that goes on holds its own continuation', 'for order' and 'named order', besides the fifth pass's list. test_chinese_fronts asserts the Chinese counterparts and the absence of 列出的进程, 尚未合为一条定理, 与之一同延续者, 渐渐 and 一个继续下去的生命.

Cover: the Philosophy row asked 'whether order comes with scope where relations close', the fifth pass's 07 §4 phrase, which 07 no longer says (grep: no home has it). It now asks 'whether the scope and order the ranking results assume are located and stated at their strength; whether, where relations close, an order holding one's own continuation ranks every widening above, as chapter 7 says; and whether known work is credited'. Chinese: 给诸进程排序的结果所预设的范围与次序，是否放对了位置、放在恰当的强度上；在关系闭合之处，持守自身延续的一种次序，是否如第七章所说把每一个扩大都排在上面. Nothing else on either cover says ethics, C or warrant. The covers' stated times hold as counted (10-13; 9-11). research-config.json: every string was scanned for the frame words (warrant, two readings, for order, gives order, unasserted, grounded, second premise/reading, better, C or self-concern, named order, not yet joined, listed courses, holds its own continuation, ethic, widening, condition, self-concern, 伦理, 扩大, 延续条件). Only the path #philosophical-warrant (an anchor), a record id and the lineage card's 'three threads (... the ethics)' match. The site description has no ethics sentence, so nothing changed. README-LEAD has no ethics, C or warrant wording, so nothing changed. navigation.py: the homes phase's verifiers had already re-said the Start-here tail, WHERE_TO_LOOK (the warrant 'set aside as one the map does not need'), OPEN_LEAD's 08 keys and its heading, and the 'Under the continuation condition' section. I checked each against F1-F9 and the homes. One fix (E8): in that section, 'widening is what every positive weighting ranks higher' now says 'on a finite listing widening is exactly what every positive weighting ranks higher', as `Weighting.widens_iff_every_positive` states. Nothing pins the phrase.

for_ren: The first screen's ethics paragraph and its how-far clause, in English and Chinese (_process/navigation/README-FIRST-SCREEN.md and README-ZH.md). This is the anchor each front follows. It says that a life goes on through what sustains it, and that where relations close (read without time) the continuation condition holds on one reading: what has significance from a standpoint is what its center continues with. There, an order a life holds over its own continuation already ranks every widening above what it widens. Widening is what every way of counting each thing as worth something agrees on, and it is no second premise. Where relations run one way, seeing those who depend on one is needed and not enough, and counting their loss is the one step offered. The how-far clause says what is proved: on a finite listing, and between two courses that end, for which it is shown; for courses that go on forming without end it is not shown. It also says that a life forming such an order is argued, not shown.

Whether 'argued' is right for a life forming an order over its own continuation. Your 8 November words (what does not want more future ceases to exist) are the argument the work has. The homes now say that going on is not yet an order (a stone goes on and ranks nothing).
The review cover's Philosophy row, which now asks reviewers whether, where relations close, an order holding one's own continuation ranks every widening above, as chapter 7 says.
